messages:
dara: Quick follow-up from the all-hands on partner asks. We surfaced a few at-risk bookings—can someone paste a one-line state + single next action for each so exec can decide tradeoffs? I'll hold here for 20m.

sylvie: From sales — super terse: 
- VertexEdge: $450k ARR, blocker = SOC2 artifact + partner onboarding queue. Next action: provide SOC pack + schedule 1h CISO call. Owner: sylvie.
- Pylon Health: $210k ARR, blocker = integration SLA + data routability questions. Next action: offer 30-day onboarding credit + technical playbook. Owner: omar.
- Riverbank (renewal): $90k ARR, blocker = PO delay. Next action: send procurement packet + payment terms. Owner: kevin.

omar: Partner ops note: VertexEdge is working with IntegrateX; IntegrateX requested a technical wedge from us to validate routing. We can provide a 48h wedge if leadership approves.

kevin: Roadmap hit estimate: pulling a wedge delays the routing perf milestone by ~1 sprint. If revenue protection is prioritized, we can move resources for 2 sprints.

tia: Legal/finance: I can draft a temporary onboarding credit agreement for Pylon and a procurement packet for Riverbank today. For VertexEdge SOC artifacts, ops already has a template I can attach.

dara: Proposal: prioritize VertexEdge and Pylon for this week, Riverbank keep on standard cadence. If that sounds right, we'll reassign two engineers for wedges and spike work. Please confirm owners + ETA.

sylvie: Confirmed owner + will email VertexEdge CISO today.

omar: I can assign an engineer for a 48h wedge starting Monday; will post who in thread by EOD.

kevin: I'll replan the sprint board and add a note about the one-sprint delay. Link: https://board.internal/sprints/49#card-5123

tia: Drafts posted: https://docs.internal/onboard/vertex-pylon-riverbank. Added procurement packet for Riverbank.

reminder-bot: Standup created: "Partner triage - VertexEdge/Pylon" tomorrow 09:00 PST. Attendees: sylvie, omar, kevin, tia, dara. Link: https://calendar.internal/evt/2065001234

dara: Thanks all — we'll run the quick standup and decide resource tradeoffs. If anyone has new info before then, drop it here.
